episode.title_zh: 小猫舞蹈社面试：能放回刚才那首吗？
episode.theme_zh: 大学舞蹈社招新。认真练熟一首歌的小猫遇到临场换音乐，在银灰室友的帮助下，从只会背动作到能先听节奏再跳；用具体的面试尴尬、友情和小进步制造共鸣。
episode.arc_zh: 十镜共约72.92秒。前两镜约14.58秒，先展示小猫跳熟歌的自信，再用换歌后的停顿建立反差和悬念。中段坦白准备方式、现场跟学、出现协调错误、找到拍子、与室友一起练习，再独立应对陌生音乐。第九镜得到试训机会，第十镜用“现在能放回我那首了吗”回收开场台词，两只猫轻松跳起熟悉的小组合。面试官始终只用画外音，室友热心且真诚，最终成就是试训资格。

shots.beat_zh: 自备展示开始：主角先跳出一小段练熟的舞蹈，刚露出自信，面试官便要求换歌。
shots.time_of_day_zh: 初秋晴天下午，整场面试保持同一光线
shots.location_zh: 大学舞蹈社招新排练室，中央蓝色圆点附近
action_timeline_zh: 0.00–1.80秒：第一帧已在舞池内。主角后爪站稳，一只前爪抬至胸前，马上开始熟悉的小踏步；镜头低位拍全身。
1.80–5.40秒：镜头平滑后退并稍抬高；主角完成左右踏步、两次轻摆爪和定点，室友在右侧后景欣慰点头。
5.40–7.29秒：主角稳稳收住动作。面试官画外说“好，换首歌继续。”主角耳朵微动，表情从自信变成疑问。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Photorealistic horizontal 1344x768 still in the same university dance-club audition studio: pale oak floor, cream walls, tall windows on screen-left, gray door at rear-right, a small black speaker near the left wall, and one blue circular floor marker. Warm late-afternoon daylight with soft ceiling fill; no readable signs, mirrors, extra animals or visible interviewer. A dynamic low diagonal view from just above the floor, 28mm-equivalent lens. The small tabby-and-white protagonist fills the near center of frame, one white forepaw lifted below its chest and hind paws poised for its practiced side step. Its ears are high, eyes bright and focused, tail balancing the pose; confidence is visible before the music changes. The silver-gray roommate is smaller at the far screen-right, watching with an approving expression. Sunlight forms a narrow stripe across the oak boards and leading floor lines draw the eye to the two cats. Both protagonist hind paws and the blue marker remain readable.
shots.motion_prompt_en: VIEW: low frontal full-body shot of the protagonist performing a prepared audition routine. CAMERA: slowly dolly back about 0.5m and raise from paw level toward chest level without crossing the room axis. ACTION 0–1.8s: begin one small side step immediately. 1.8–5.4s: perform left-close, right-close, two modest forepaw pulses and a stable pose; expressive but anatomically feline, no jumps or human hip isolation. The roommate gives one small approving nod. 5.4–7.29s: hold the finished pose, then turn ears toward the offscreen panel as the song-change request is heard. END STATE: confident pose beginning to soften into uncertainty. Preserve the room and both identities; avoid cuts, exaggerated limbs and background dancers.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Soft paw contacts on the oak floor and quiet rehearsal-room reverberation; a small rustle of fur.
must_preserve_en: The protagonist's brown tabby crown and back, white facial blaze, chest and four white paws
The protagonist's compact feline body, pink nose, hazel eyes and fluffy ringed tail; no costume changes
The roommate's silver-gray coat, round face, black collar and round pendant whenever visible
Warm afternoon light, pale oak floor, screen-left windows and the room's spatial layout
The blue floor marker remains under or just beside the protagonist; the roommate stays screen-right behind it
must_avoid_en: Human hands, fingers, human torsos, stretched legs, extra limbs or additional tails
Swapping the two cats' identities, transferring the roommate's collar to the protagonist, or merging their bodies
Captions, subtitles, readable signs, logos, watermarks or visible reference-sheet labels

Starting with a corridor, doorway introduction or an empty room before the dance

utterances.cue_en: After the protagonist finishes its prepared dance and holds its pose.

audio.diegetic_music_prompt_en: An original vocal-free pop-funk groove around 112 BPM, clear percussion and a short bright bass motif, played from a rehearsal speaker. It plays immediately, becomes quieter during the interviewer's line, and stops as the shot ends.

shots.beat_zh: 新音乐一响，主角按旧节奏多跳半步后卡住，向室友求助，再小声问能否放回原来的歌。
shots.time_of_day_zh: 同日下午，紧接自备展示
shots.location_zh: 同一舞蹈社排练室，主角仍在中央蓝色圆点附近
action_timeline_zh: 0.00–1.80秒：陌生音乐开始；主角凭惯性按旧节奏踏一步、抬爪，忽然发现不对。
1.80–4.20秒：主角脚已经停住，一只前爪还悬着；它慢慢看向右侧室友。室友本要鼓掌，爪子也尴尬地停住。
4.20–6.60秒：镜头轻推近，主角转回面试官方向，小声说“能放回刚才那首吗？”
6.60–7.29秒：保留短暂安静的表情停顿，主角耳朵略向侧面转，室友用眼神安慰。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Photorealistic horizontal 1344x768 still in the same university dance-club audition studio: pale oak floor, cream walls, tall windows on screen-left, gray door at rear-right, a small black speaker near the left wall, and one blue circular floor marker. Warm late-afternoon daylight with soft ceiling fill; no readable signs, mirrors, extra animals or visible interviewer. A wide low view from beside the black speaker, 35mm-equivalent lens, echoing the previous dance floor but changing the visual rhythm abruptly. The speaker is a dark near-left foreground shape; the protagonist stands on the blue marker in the middle distance with one hind paw halted a fraction off the floor and one forepaw frozen mid-gesture. Its ears tilt unevenly and its eyes search for the new beat. A broad patch of bare oak floor isolates it. The roommate remains at screen-right, half-raised paws paused before a clap, its concerned gaze directed at the protagonist. Show the missed beat and social embarrassment through body language, not a fall.
shots.motion_prompt_en: VIEW: a readable full-body view that gradually becomes a medium-full two-shot. CAMERA: a slow 0.3m push toward the protagonist, with a slight lateral move revealing the roommate; never orbit behind either cat. ACTION 0–1.8s: the protagonist makes one step at the earlier, faster pace, then notices the unfamiliar beat. 1.8–4.2s: stop its feet while one forepaw remains lifted; look to the roommate, whose intended clap freezes midway. 4.2–6.6s: turn toward the offscreen interviewer and timidly deliver the assigned short line with subtle muzzle movement. 6.6–7.29s: hold an embarrassed but endearing pause. END STATE: still on its feet, needing help; no fall or sudden change in skill.

It begins immediately after the change of song and becomes quieter when the protagonist speaks.

shots.beat_zh: 主角坦白自己只跟一首歌练过；银灰室友本想帮忙补充，最后温和地点头。
shots.time_of_day_zh: 同日下午，换歌后的短暂停顿
shots.location_zh: 排练室中央，面向镜头外的面试官
action_timeline_zh: 0.00–2.00秒：主角收低前爪，认真听面试官问“平时怎么练的？”室友在右后方等待。
2.00–3.50秒：主角先瞟一眼室友，再看回面试官，出现一个不好意思但诚实的停顿。
3.50–6.00秒：主角小声回答“就……跟着这首练的。”室友微微张口想帮忙，最后只是点头。
6.00–7.29秒：主角露出一点不好意思的笑意，室友靠近半步，给它支持而不抢话。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Photorealistic horizontal 1344x768 still in the same university dance-club audition studio: pale oak floor, cream walls, tall windows on screen-left, gray door at rear-right, a small black speaker near the left wall, and one blue circular floor marker. Warm late-afternoon daylight with soft ceiling fill; no readable signs, mirrors, extra animals or visible interviewer. A quiet feline-eye-level medium portrait two-shot, 55mm-equivalent lens. The protagonist occupies the left foreground, shoulders and face prominent; ears slightly lowered, whiskers forward, eyes dropping briefly toward the floor as it prepares to admit it practiced only one song. The roommate stands half a step behind on the right, collar and round pendant visible, expression gentle rather than pitying. The panel stays outside the frame. The blue marker is a small soft shape at the bottom edge; warm window highlights separate the two faces from the cream wall.
shots.motion_prompt_en: VIEW: quiet eye-level medium two-shot during the audition interview. CAMERA: almost stationary, with a very slow natural push no more than 0.15m. ACTION 0–2s: the protagonist listens to the interviewer. 2–3.5s: glance briefly at the roommate and return attention to the panel. 3.5–6s: give the hesitant Mandarin answer; use restrained jaw and muzzle movement without human lips. The roommate starts to react, then offers a small supportive nod. 6–7.29s: the roommate steps only half a paw-length closer; the protagonist settles. END STATE: honest vulnerability and a friendly alliance, with no hostile reaction.

shots.beat_zh: 面试进入现场跟学环节，室友示范一组简单四拍动作，主角认真观察却忍不住提前动。
shots.time_of_day_zh: 同日下午，现场跟学开始
shots.location_zh: 同一排练室，主角左侧、室友右侧并排站立
action_timeline_zh: 0.00–1.20秒：面试官画外说“跟着学一小段。”两只猫转成并排，主角盯着室友。
1.20–4.50秒：室友示范一次简单组合：向左小踏一步、合脚、向右踏一步、合脚并轻轻摆爪。
4.50–6.20秒：主角认真看着，没等室友结束便提前抬起一只前爪，意识到抢拍后又收住。
6.20–7.29秒：室友停在准备姿势，向主角点头，示意轮到它。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Photorealistic horizontal 1344x768 still in the same university dance-club audition studio: pale oak floor, cream walls, tall windows on screen-left, gray door at rear-right, a small black speaker near the left wall, and one blue circular floor marker. Warm late-afternoon daylight with soft ceiling fill; no readable signs, mirrors, extra animals or visible interviewer. A clear oblique two-cat full-body composition from the front-right side of the studio, 35mm-equivalent lens. The silver-gray roommate is closer at screen-right with one forepaw ready to mark the four-count, while the smaller protagonist stands screen-left and slightly farther back, studying its feet. Leave a clean half-body gap and show both sets of hind paws, tails and the blue marker between them. Floorboard diagonals and the window light give depth, so this feels like a practical teaching moment rather than two cats posing for a portrait.
shots.motion_prompt_en: VIEW: steady front-right three-quarter full-body two-shot. CAMERA: a gentle lateral slide of about 0.25m, retaining both complete bodies and the room axis. ACTION 0–1.2s: both cats listen to the offscreen instruction. 1.2–4.5s: the roommate demonstrates one compact left-step, close, right-step, close pattern with small forepaw pulses; no human limb proportions. The protagonist watches. 4.5–6.2s: the protagonist raises a forepaw slightly too early, notices, and resets without performing a second full routine. 6.2–7.29s: the roommate gives an encouraging nod and holds a ready stance. END STATE: the protagonist is ready to try the same four-count exercise.

shots.beat_zh: 主角尝试模仿，前爪和脚步一时配合不上；室友发现它越想记越乱，提醒它先只顾脚步。
shots.time_of_day_zh: 同日下午，第一次跟学尝试
shots.location_zh: 同一排练室中央蓝色标记旁
action_timeline_zh: 0.00–2.10秒：主角先把前爪动作做出来，脚却踏向反方向，动作很小，不摔倒。
2.10–4.10秒：它低头改脚步，前爪又停在半空，耳朵微微侧转，显出努力记动作的慌张。
4.10–5.70秒：室友温和示意它先放低前爪，说“先跟脚，别急。”
5.70–7.29秒：主角把前爪放低，重新站稳，只尝试一次很小的踏步。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Photorealistic horizontal 1344x768 still in the same university dance-club audition studio: pale oak floor, cream walls, tall windows on screen-left, gray door at rear-right, a small black speaker near the left wall, and one blue circular floor marker. Warm late-afternoon daylight with soft ceiling fill; no readable signs, mirrors, extra animals or visible interviewer. A floor-level medium-full view with the white hind paw nearest the lens planted just on the wrong side of the blue marker. The protagonist is still visible from paws to ears above it, forepaws out of sync, brows and ear angle showing concentrated confusion rather than slapstick panic. The roommate is a distinct silver-gray figure behind on screen-right, lowering its own forepaws as a calm cue. Use a 30mm-equivalent lens and enough depth of field to read the misplaced paw, the protagonist face and the roommate reaction in one glance.
shots.motion_prompt_en: VIEW: floor-level medium-full view emphasizing the misplaced hind paw, with the whole cat still readable. CAMERA: hold a low stable angle and make only a slight push; keep both hind paws and the confused face in frame. ACTION 0–2.1s: raise a forepaw while taking one small step in the wrong direction. 2.1–4.1s: look down and correct the hind paw, inadvertently pausing the forepaw; depict one simple coordination error, not a cascade of falls. 4.1–5.7s: the roommate lowers its own forepaws as a calm visual cue and speaks briefly. 5.7–7.29s: the protagonist copies the reset, relaxes its forepaws and attempts a single small side step. END STATE: a simpler, steadier starting position.

shots.beat_zh: 主角先听拍子、轻点头，再让脚步跟上，最后才加一点摆爪；它第一次真正找到新音乐的节奏。
shots.time_of_day_zh: 同日下午，重新尝试陌生音乐
shots.location_zh: 同一舞蹈社排练室中央
action_timeline_zh: 0.00–1.80秒：主角保持站稳，认真听新音乐，只轻轻点头两次。
1.80–4.60秒：它开始左右小踏步，速度比开场更从容，脚步逐渐与节奏贴合。
4.60–6.30秒：在稳定脚步上加两次幅度很小的前爪摆动，眼睛不再一直盯着地板。
6.30–7.29秒：它抬头看向室友，嘴角和耳朵放松，露出“这次跟上了”的小表情。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Photorealistic horizontal 1344x768 still in the same university dance-club audition studio: pale oak floor, cream walls, tall windows on screen-left, gray door at rear-right, a small black speaker near the left wall, and one blue circular floor marker. Warm late-afternoon daylight with soft ceiling fill; no readable signs, mirrors, extra animals or visible interviewer. A stiller three-quarter full-body profile from screen-left, 45mm-equivalent lens. The protagonist stands alone in the lit center of the rehearsal floor with both hind paws planted, forepaws relaxed, head slightly angled toward the unseen speaker. One ear rim catches warm light; its expression has shifted from frustrated to carefully listening. The roommate is only a soft silver-gray presence farther back on the right. Keep generous open floor around the body so the coming first in-time step can be seen clearly.
shots.motion_prompt_en: VIEW: a clean full-body observation of a small genuine improvement. CAMERA: slowly slide from a slight three-quarter view toward a near-frontal view, within a 15-degree arc; no dramatic orbit. ACTION 0–1.8s: listen and make two tiny head nods. 1.8–4.6s: begin unhurried left-close-right-close steps in time with the clear pulse. 4.6–6.3s: add two restrained forepaw pulses while maintaining balance with the tail. 6.3–7.29s: lift the gaze toward the roommate and soften the expression. END STATE: still a beginner, but noticeably steadier and able to continue on the unfamiliar music.

shots.beat_zh: 室友站到它旁边陪练，主动缩小动作、给清楚提示；主角跟上后终于抬头和它对视。
shots.time_of_day_zh: 同日下午，短暂双人跟练
shots.location_zh: 同一排练室，蓝色圆点左右各一只猫
action_timeline_zh: 0.00–1.50秒：两只猫并排站好，室友看向主角，轻轻点头给出开始信号。
1.50–4.90秒：两只猫一起做左右踏步和轻摆爪，室友动作更小、更清楚，主角逐渐跟上。
4.90–6.20秒：主角从盯脚转为抬头看室友，两只猫交换一个短暂的笑意。
6.20–7.29秒：两只猫在同一拍自然停住，保留彼此之间的距离，不牵手、不拥抱。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Photorealistic horizontal 1344x768 still in the same university dance-club audition studio: pale oak floor, cream walls, tall windows on screen-left, gray door at rear-right, a small black speaker near the left wall, and one blue circular floor marker. Warm late-afternoon daylight with soft ceiling fill; no readable signs, mirrors, extra animals or visible interviewer. An intimate diagonal two-cat full-body view from slightly behind the protagonist on screen-left, 40mm-equivalent lens. The protagonist and the roommate on screen-right share the blue marker but do not overlap; both have hind paws ready for the same small side step. The roommate lowers its gestures to beginner size and meets the protagonist gaze; the protagonist finally lifts its head toward that look. Sunlit floor lines and a mild background falloff emphasize their relationship while all four paws and two distinct tails remain readable.
shots.motion_prompt_en: VIEW: an intimate but readable full-body two-cat practice shot. CAMERA: track laterally only about 0.3m in the same direction as their small movement, without changing their left-right order. ACTION 0–1.5s: the roommate offers an encouraging nod. 1.5–4.9s: both perform the simple left-close-right-close pattern and low forepaw pulses; the roommate marks the moves gently, and the protagonist follows with gradually improving coordination. 4.9–6.2s: the protagonist raises its gaze and shares a brief relieved look with its friend. 6.2–7.29s: finish together in a modest balanced stance. END STATE: support and growing confidence, not a polished competition duet.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Two pairs of soft paw contacts with natural variations in loudness, quiet breathing and indoor room tone.

END STATE: happy relief and friendship; the progress from the audition remains real.
